contract: Mif_Port_Data_t changed/delay fields describe the current callback staging state; output values are read only after output() assigned changed ports.
EVTprocess_output moves the staged next_event to the output queue after the code-model callback, at evt_step plus delay.
Each selected port is mapped by evt_data.output_index; the observer walks the full linked list from *queue.current[index], including removed entries.
removed_time is read only when removed is true. Current-list coverage does not serialize past, free or other-model queue entries.
scope: Pinned ngspice 47 internal layout and callback semantics; backend or ABI changes require rebuilding and reviewing the observer.
